Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the second half! The Indian players make their way out to the middle and so do the South African openers.
... THE CHASE ...

The target is not a big one but surely a tricky one. The wicket is on the slower side and it is turning. India have a few good spinners and that will probably be the contest which decides the game. Can the South African batters tackle the spinners well? We will find out.
Yash Dhull says that he is happy but will look to give 100%. Says the wicket is a touch slow but their fielding is good and will look to defend it out.

For South Africa, the key for them was they kept picking wickets at regular intervals. Even when the game seemed like drifting away their bowlers always got them back into it. Matthew Boast and Aphiwe Mnyanda were really good first up. Liam Alder was excellent in the middle overs. Michael Copeland also did his job. Overall, it was a decent effort by their bowlers.

South Africa though let the advantage slip they had earlier on, they got two early but then Yash Dhull along with Shaik Rasheed, Sindhu and Bawa turned the tide in India's favor. Dhull played really well for his half ton but fell at the wrong time. When he departed, India were in a spot of bother but Tambe got the momentum back towards their side and when he was batting 250 looked possible. However, wickets fell in a heap at the end and they have fallen short of what they would have liked to be.

A really good effort from South Africa Under-19 towards the back end and they have kept India in-check! Probably India have a score which is just over par but South Africa won't feel out of the contest and also, will be the happier side of the two.
OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! The drop doesn't count much. Flatter and on off, it lands and spins sharply. Ostwal rocks back and slashes it back to Dewald Brevis. Good catch. India are all out at 232.
FOUR! Dropped at long off! Full and on off. Vicky Ostwal looks to go big but slices it towards long off where the fielder palms it over for a boundary.
Full and outside off, pushed to cover.
Tossed up, on middle, swept to deep square leg. The fielder gives a chase and flicks it back to save a couple.
This one lands on off and spins away. Ostwal prods to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
A full ball, very full, on off. Kumar works it to point.
On a length, on middle. Kumar blocks it out.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Matthew Boast is on a Hat-Trick now! A short ball, on middle. Rajvardhan Hangargekar tries to pull but it takes the top edge and high in the air. The keeper is wrong-footed for a minute but did well to pouch it.
Commentary.Howout: c Kaden Solomons b Matthew Boast

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! What a catch! Brilliant reflexes from Andile Simelane! A length ball, outside off. Tambe cuts it hard and straight to point where Andile Simelane takes a sharp catch. That came like a bullet but Simelane did really well.
Commentary.Howout: c Andile Simelane b Matthew Boast

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on the pads, this is flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Short and outside off. Ostwal hops and taps it to point.
Another single as this is pushed down to long on.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on.
On middle, defended.
Another one on the shorter side, this is slapped down to long off for one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On off, defended.
Vicky Ostwal comes in.

OUT! TIMBER! That has just about clipped the off pole. Bana makes room. Boast bowls it full and on off at pace. Bana is late in getting his bat down and he misses. It clips the off pole. South Africa continue chipping away at the wickets. Can they keep them under 250?
A single now as this is pushed through covers.
FOUR! Up and over! Fuller and on off, this is lofted over covers for a boundary. Welcome boundary.
WIDE! Down the leg side, it is left alone.
Good field placement! There is a widish slip in the 44th over. Shorter and on off, Tambe looks to guide it down to third man but finds the fielder.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
On middle, Bana sweeps it through mid-wicket for one.
A single now! Outside off, this is played through covers for one.
Another dot! On off, Tambe pushes it to covers.
A dot! Shorter and on off, Tambe pushes it to covers.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one more.
On middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
A dot to end! Outside off, Bana looks to lift it over covers but misses.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the body, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side, shorter in length. It is left alone.
Fuller and on off, Tambe pushes it to mid off.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Tambe looks to flick but misses.
Shorter and on middle, it is ducked under.
On middle, fuller, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Cut away and in the gap! Shorter and outside off, Tambe cuts it through point for a boundary.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is nudged through mid-wicket for one.
Comes down the track and hits it hard but it hits the batter at the other end.
On middle, defended.
Powerplay 3 time! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 50th over.
Tossed up, on off. Kept out.
Full and on off. Tambe skips down and drives it to covers, the fielder puts a big dive to his right and stops it. A single.
Full and on off, pushed on the off side.
Tossed up, on off. Tambe blocks it out.
Angles it on the pads, Bana flicks it past square leg. The fielder does really well to chase it down and save a single.
Full and outside off, tucked away to square leg for a single.

OUT! RUN OUT! What a brilliant piece of fielding. South Africa have got rid of the Indian skipper at a crucial stage. This will clearly make the difference for the last 11 overs! Short and on off, spins nicely. Dhull taps it to point and looks for a quick single but was sent back from halfway mark. Andile Simelane there scores a direct hit at the striker's end and Dhull looked short. The replay confirms the same as well. A fine innings comes to an end.
A direct hit and it seems like the batter is short! This is going to be a big wicket.
This is classic leg-spin. Lands on middle and turns away. Dhull is beaten as he looks to defend on the front foot.
FOUR! Tossed up, outside off. Dhull drives it through covers for a boundary.
Short and on middle. Tambe tucks it to square leg for a single.
Outside off, Tambe lets it through.
FOUR! Nicely played! A short ball, outside off. Tambe cuts it, past slip and also beats the third man fielder for a boundary. Good batting.
Flatter and on middle. Dhull works it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Cheeky! Yash Dhull makes room for himself. This is short and on off. Dhull gets an outside edge as he cuts it to the third man fence.
Drifts this one on off. Tambe pushes it to covers for a single.
Short and outside off. Left alone.
An arm ball, on off. Tambe taps it to point.
Full again, stays low, outside off, Dhull hits it to cover for a sinngle.
Single to end the over as this is pushed to long off for one more.
Good fielding! Flatter and outside off. Tambe guides it past slip and towards short third man who dives to his right and stops it.
On off, pushed to covers.
A loopy ball, on off. Tambe defends it out.
Now sloppy work from the backward point fielder as he gives away an easy single. Short and outside off again.
Short and outside off. Dhull slaps it to backward point.
This is full and on off. Dhull whips it to mid-wicket who dives to his right and half-stops. Single and Dhull will retain the strike.
On middle, pushed to mid on.
Quick single! Tossed up, on off. Tambe pushes it to mid on and gets to the other end quickly.
Full and on middle. Defended off the front foot.
On middle, Tambe works it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Caressed! Short and outside off. Tambe cuts it through cover-point, the fielder gives a chase and tries to flick it back but fails. Good effort but another boundary added to the total.
Full again, on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Full ball, outside off, driven to extra cover.
Full toss, whipped to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! This one skids through, outside off. Tambe dabs it late and past first slip for a boundary.
A full toss, on middle. Tambe hits it to mid-wicket.
Darted on the pads, flicked to square leg for a single.
A solid defense from Kaushal Tambe to end the over.
Around off, fuller length. Tambe blocks it towards cover.
WIDE! This is the 17th wide bowled! Full and down the leg side. Tambe misses his flick.
A loopy ball, on middle. Dhull gets on the front foot and tucks it to square leg. One.
Full and on off. Kept out.
FOUR! This is short and way outside off. Dhull cuts it through point for another boundary.
Flatter and on middle, punched to mid off.

OUT! LBW! Dewald Brevis gets a wicket in his very first over and in the last ball! This is short and on middle. Raj Angad Bawa tries to pull but it doesn't bounce at low, The ball stays low and hits him plumb on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger. Another Indian batter who gets a start but fails to continue.
This one spins back in, on off. Bawa cuts it to short third man.
Tossed up, on off. Dhull pushes it back to the bowler who dives over it and gives away a single.
Full and on off, Blocked out.
On middle. Dhull defends it with soft hands and gets an outside edge past first slip to third man for a couple.
A flighted ball, full and outside off. Bawa drives it to deep cover for a single.

DRINKS! India are on top now! They are well on course for a big score, Dhull though is the mainstay. He needs to stay for long. South Africa on the other hand, have let their advantage slip away they had early in the game. They need to take wickets now or they will be chasing a big total. An important passage of play awaits.
Another solid block from Dhull, this was full and on off.
Flighted ball, drifting on middle. Dhull keeps it out.
Loopy ball, on middle. Blocked out.
Darted on the pads, this is flicked to square leg for one run.
This is short and angling outside off. Bawa looks to cut but misses.
Tossed up, on middle, pushed to long off for one more.
FOUR! Runs are coming nicely for India now! A full toss, friendly on middle. Bawa just lifts it over mid on for a boundary. Also, 150 up for India.
Full and outside off. Dhull wrists it to long on and rotates the strike.
This one stays low and spins back in, outside off, this is worked through mid on for a single.
Tossed up, on off, eased down to long on for one more.
Good running! Full and drifting on the pads, Bawa hits it to mid on for a single.
Full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
WIDE! Flatter and down the leg side. Bawa misses his pull.
FOUR! Extraordinary shot! Boundary to end the over. This is on a length, on middle. Dhull whips it uppishly and over mid on for a boundary.
FOUR! Well played! Short and wide outside off. Dhull slashes it nicely and to point for a boundary.
Fuller now, on off. Bawa pushes off the outer half to third man for one.
Short of a length, on middle. Bawa tucks it with soft hands to square leg and takes a couple of runs.
Length ball, on middle. Raj Angad Bawa solidly defends it.
Length and on middle. Blocked out.
Another single as this is punched to long off.
On middle, drilled down to long on for a single. Fifty for Yash Dhull, a captain's knock and he knows he has to continue further.
Full and on middle, this is hit to mid on for a quick single. Good running.
Full again. Raj Angad Bawa comes down the track and smashes it to mid off who does well to stop it.
Full and on middle. Blocked out.
A googly, around off. Dhull rocks back and punches it to long off for one.
A slower bumper, Dhull does play it a little awkwardly towards square leg for one.

Half an appeal but turned down! On the pads, the batter looks to flick, he misses to get hit high on the pads. It rolls towards point. The fielder there has a needless shy at the keeper's end but misses. A single is taken then.
Fuller and on middle, Dhull pushes it towards mid on for one.
Fuller and on off, Dhull pushes it to mid off.
On middle, Dhull pushes it to mid on.
Good length and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Solid! On off, defended.
Raj Angad Bawa walks out to the middle.

OUT! STUMPED! Sindhu is short and that is excellent keeping! Once again, just as the momentum seemed to be shifting, South Africa strike! This is a lovely delivery, it is tossed up nicely, around off, it draws Sindhu into the drive but the ball lands and turns away sharply. There is also extra bounce. It goes past the outside edge, Sindhu seems to have dragged his back foot out. The keeper collects it nicely and then whips the bails off. The keeper starts celebrating but the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays show that Sindhu is short but by just. The game was slipping away from the bowling side as Sindhu was scoring quickly. Can they now stem it?
Commentary.Howout: st Kaden Solomons b Michael Copeland

Commentary.Commentary: A stumping review! The replay shows the back foot was out of the line but coming in as the bails are clipped off. It is touch and go...Out shows the big screen.
FOUR! Hammered! That is put away nicely! Can't bowl bad balls to Sindhu. A full toss on middle, this is whipped through mid-wicket. It races away to the fence.
On middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
On the stumps, defended.
On off, this is eased down to long off for one.
A good looking stroke there! Shorter and on off, Dhull pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! Dhull got some width and some length to play with! It is short and wide outside off, this is slapped through covers for a boundary.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the middle pole, defended.
Really good fielding! Shorter and on the pads, this is worked wide of mid on. The fielder dives and keeps it down to one.
On the pads, Sindhu works it to mid-wicket. This is probably the right line to Sindhu. Cramping him for room.
On middle, Sindhu defends.
FOUR! Boundaries are flowing now! Shorter and outside off, Dhull rocks back and cuts it through point. This one races away to the fence.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Slightly shorter, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On middle, Sindhu works it through mid-wicket for one.
On the pads, this is clipped through square leg for one.
On middle, Dhull works it to mid-wicket.
That is a better line to Sindhu! Shorter and on middle, defended.
FOUR! Yet another boundary for Sindhu and this is off the front foot! Full and on off, this is driven beautifully and into the fence.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Sindhu looks to flick but misses.
FOUR! Put away! Shorter and outside off, Sindhu plays it through point. Another boundary for him. He is dealing in boundaries. 3 in the 15 he has scored.
On the pads, Dhull works it down to fine leg and takes one.
Bangs it short, gets good bounce. Defended well with soft hands and onto the ground.
Good length and on off, Dhull pushes it to covers.
On middle, Dhull works it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end. Good, sensible batting.
A full toss, just the one as it is eased down to long off.
FOUR! Width on offer and put away! Short and outside off, Sindhu slaps it through covers and bags another boundary. His second.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on middle, Sindhu pushes it to covers.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! Lovely stroke for his first boundary! Shorter and around off, Sindhu stands tall and pushes it through covers. This one races away to the fence.
Shorter and on the body, this is worked towards mid-wicket.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Edge but wide! Shorter and on middle, Sindhu looks to defend, extra bounce, it goes off the outside edge, wide of first slip and down to third man for one.
On middle, Sindhu stays back and blocks.
Good length and on off, Sindhu pushes it to covers.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
On the stumps, blocked.
Tosses it up on middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Fuller again, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is played back to the bowler.
Fuller and on off, Dhull pushes it to covers.
On off, Sindhu pushes it to covers.
On off, Sindhu lunges and defends.
Nishant Sindhu is the new main in.

OUT! LBW! That is as plumb as it gets! Liam breaks the stand that was going along so nicely. A well-deserved wicket, he has bowled really well and finally gets the reward. Rasheed looks to sweep but this delivery is quite full, it also dips towards the end. Rasheed misses as it sneaks under his bat and hits the pad. An appeal and up goes the finger. Will this open the floodgates now? Shaik Rasheed goes back after getting off to a good start.
On middle, defended.
Nicely played! Fuller and on off, Rasheed makes room and strokes it through covers. Two taken.
This is fired full and on middle, it is pushed down to long off for one.
That is a really good shot but only for one! Fuller and outside off, Dhull strokes it wide of long off. He gets to the ball quickly and keeps it down to one.
Delicate! Just outside off, Dhull uses the pace of the bowler and guides it past short third man for two.
On middle, kept out.
Another run! Fuller and on middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
Fuller and on middle, Rasheed looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On middle, this is pushed but the man at mid-wicket, dives to his left and saves a run.
A dot to end! On off, Dhull leans into it and strokes it to covers.
On off, Dhull pushes it to covers.

EDGY FOUR! Fortune right now favoring India! Really well bowled, Tosses it up, draws the batter forward for a drive. It lands and then spins away, it goes off the outside edge past the slip fielder and down to the third man fence.
Yet another dot! Tight stuff! On middle, defended.
Slightly shorter and on off, Dhull pushes it to covers.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed to mid on.
BEATEN! That one holds its line! Outside off, flatter, skids through. Rasheed looks to push at it but is beaten.
On middle, Rasheed gets right behind the line and defends.
Well fielded! Shorter and on off, Rasheed pushes it towards cover. The fielder there dives to his left and stops it nicely.
On middle, Dhull pushes it down to long on for one.

Good recovery in the end! This is full and outside off, it is driven through covers. The man at long off runs to his left, slides but ends up pushing it away from him and towards the ropes, he gets up quickly, puts in another dive and saves a run for his side.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Michael Copeland is into the attack now.
A snigle to end the over then! Shorter in length and on off, Rasheed pushes it towards cover and gets to the other end.
Looks to toss it up but bowls it a little too full, it is pushed down to long off for one.
Slightly flatter this time and on off, Dhull plays it back to the bowler.
Good running! On off, another one slower through the air, Rasheed plays it with the turn towards cover for one.
Turn! Decent amount of turn! Lovely delivery. Liam slows it up and lands it on off, it lands and then spins away. Rasheed looks to defend but is beaten.
Fuller and on middle, this is played back to the bowler.
Drop and run! On a length and on off, Rasheed pushes it towards cover and gets to the other end.
Back of a length and on off, Rasheed pushes it to covers.
Outside off now, left alone.
Well fielded! This is another full delivery, it is firmly driven down towards mid on. The fielder dives to his left and makes a half stop. A single.
WIDE! Another extra! Down the leg side, Dhull looks to flick but misses.
On the fuller side yet again, Dhull flicks but to mid on.
Back of a length and on off, Dhull pushes it to covers.

DRINKS! So, after the two early wickets, India have recovered nicely, Shaik Rasheed and Yash Dhull have really gone along well. The run rate is good and the two seem to have got their eye in and will now hope to cash in on a wicket which seems to be a good one to bat on. South Africa Under-19, faded away as the game progressed, They began with a bang but as India started to get on top, they started dropping catches and the bowling too has not been great. Can the break work for them? We will find out.
A single to end the over as this is drilled down to long off.
A loopy ball, on middle, Dhull tucks it to mid-wicket.
Four dots in a row! This is pushed again but straight to point.
Tossed up, outside off. Dhull pushes it to point.
On middle. Kept out.
A loopy ball, on middle, this is worked to mid on.
Full and on off, driven nicely to mid off.
A slower ball, full and outside off. Dhull has a poke but gets an inside edge to mid-wicket for a single.
Full, slanting on middle. Dhull pushes it to mid on.
Another beautiful drive but straight to mid off.
Around off, this is pushed through covers for a single.
An appeal for LBW but not given! Length ball, angling around off. Rasheed looks to defend but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over! Dhull pushes it and wide enough of mid off for a boundary.
Tossed up, on middle. Dhull pushes it to mid off.
Another solid defence from Dhull.
On middle, fuller length. Dhull defends off the front foot.
Full and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Full start to start on middle, this is hit back to Alder.
Liam Alder comes on now.
Length, outside off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Again shuffles and this time Dhull defends it with soft hands to covers for a quick single.
FOUR! 50 up for India! Angles it on the pads. Dhull shuffles and tickles it to the fine leg fence.
Full ball, on off. Dhull works it to cover.
Length and on off. Blocked out.
EDGED BUT JUST SHORT! Full ball, angling around off. Yash Dhull comes down the track but the late away movement takes the outside edge and just short of the keeper.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
On the pads, this is flicked to square leg.
Now Rasheed drives but straight to covers.
Fuller length, asking to drive but Rasheed leaves it alone.
Length ball, on middle. Rasheed blocks it out.
On middle, this is hit to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! On middle, on a length. Dhull tucks it to mid-wicket, the fielder there puts a dive but to no avail as it races away to the fence.
FOUR! Punished! Full and on off, Rasheed leans and drives it through covers for a boundary.

Dropped! Goes wide of the crease and serves it on a length, outside off. Rasheed has a push but gets an outside edge to first slip where the fielder leaps and tries to take it over his head but fumbles.
Angles a length ball, on middle. this is hit to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Too many extras! Full, slower and way outside off. Rasheed misses his cut.
Full again, outside off. Defended off the front foot.
Full and outside off, blocked to covers.
Around off. Dhull looks to defend but gets an inside edge to square leg for a single.
Andile Simelane is into the attack.
On middle. Blocked out.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Full and on middle. Shaik Rasheed shows the full face of the bat and pushes it through mid on for a boundary.
WIDE! Aphiwe Mnyanda has missed his line completely. Full and way down the leg side.
WIDE! From over the wicket but angles it way outside off. Wided.
WIDE! Again down the leg side. The keeper does well this time.
FIVE WIDES! Full and down the leg side. Shaik Rasheed misses his flick. The keeper dives to his left but misses and it races away to the fence.
A length ball from around the wicket, outside off. Yash looks to push but gets an outside edge through gully for a single.
On a length, on off. Dhull punches it off the back foot to covers.
Now comes down the track and blocks it out.
Length ball, it holds the line, outside off. Dhull looks to cut but misses.
This time clips it through mid-wicket and collects a couple of runs.
FOUR! Two in a row! Full ball, drifting on middle. Rasheed flicks it nicely and wide of mid on for a boundary.
FOUR! First aggressive shot of the match! Short and on middle, Rasheed pulls it away to mid-wicket for a boundary.
Around off, on a length. Rasheed keeps it out.
Length ball, on middle. Blocked out.
WIDE! A length ball, way outside off. Shaik Rasheed looks to cut but misses. The keeper catches it and appeals for it but the umpire instead signals a wide.
On the money, on middle. Defended on the turf.
Single to end the over as this is pushed to third man for a single.
Length and outside off. Blocked out on the off side.
Length and on off. Dhull taps it to point for a quick single.
WIDE! Full and outside off. Dhull leaves it alone.
Length ball, outside off. Dhull steps down and has a poke at it but misses.
Full ball, on off. Blocked out.
Yash Dhull walks out now.

OUT! LBW! Aphiwe Mnyanda gets another one and he has both the openers now. This is a terrific start for the Proteas. This is full, straight and on middle. Angkrish Raghuvanshi shuffles way across and looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger. India 2 down now.
Length ball, outside off, slower and Shaik Rasheed misses his cut.
Full and on off. Blocked out.
Bangs a short one now, on middle. Shaik Rasheed sits under it.
Full and outside off, this is hit to point.
On a length, outside off. Rasheed looks to defend off the front foot but misses.
Around off. Blocked out.
This is slower and on middle. Angkrish Raghuvanshi is touch early as he looks to flick and gets a leading edge to the off side.
Full and on off. Shaik Rasheed guides it to third man for a single.
Full and on off, defended to mid off.
The physio walks out to have a check. Shaik Rasheed is in some pain.

Collision but the batters make their ground. On middle. Angkrish Raghuvanshi defends it on the off side and asks for a quick single. Both the batters collide as they run across. The fielder has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. He had more time as Rasheed fumbled to reach his ground. Chance for South Africa.
Again this one is outside off, on a length. Angkrish Raghuvanshi yet again plays with two minds and eventually leaves it.
Length and slanting outside off, Angkrish Raghuvanshi leaves it very late.
BEATEN! Perfect delivery! This is on a length, outside off, in the channel. Rasheed steps across and looks to block it but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Full and angling on middle, this is hit to mid-wicket.
Good pace! Short and straight, outside off. Shaik Rasheed leaves it alone.
Short of a length, on middle, tucked to square leg for a single.
Length and on off. Kept out.
Leg bye! Another appeal for LBW but this was more of an ambitious one, was angling down leg. Rasheed looks to flick this length ball but misses and takes a leg bye off the pads to square leg.
Nicely pushed on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Shaik Rasheed is off the mark straightaway! Length and on off. Rasheed hops and pushes it through covers for one.
Shaik Rasheed walks out at number 3.

OUT! LBW! Aphiwe Mnyanda gets the breakthrough. This is on a length and angling around middle and leg. Harnoor Singh plants a big front foot out and looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger. Good bowling from Aphiwe Mnyanda, he was getting the swing and serves it nicely on the length.
On middle. Singh looks to flick but gets a soft leading edge to the leg side. This once comes back in a bit.
Overthrows! On the pads, tihs is flicked to square leg for a single. The fielder there has an unnecessary shy and no back up means the batters take two more runs.
Singh is off the mark! Full and outside off. Singh guides it through gully for a single.
WIDE! Full, outside off, swinging away more. Singh shoulders arms.
Who will be bowl from the other end? It is Aphiwe Mnyanda.
This is on a length and around off, this one comes back in sharply and hits Angkrish Raghuvanshi on the pads as he shoulders arms. Good movement early on.
WIDE! This is way down the leg side. Angkrish Raghuvanshi misses his flick. Wided.
On a length, on off. Blocked out.
On a length, on off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi keeps it out.
Outside off. Left alone.
Huge appeal for caught behind but not given. Short of a length, angling down. Angkrish Raghuvanshi looks to flick but misses. An appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Length ball, outside off. Angkrish Raghuvanshi leaves it alone.
We are all set. Angkrish Raghuvanshi and Harnoor Singh are the openers. Matthew Boast to start with the ball.
We are all set for the action but before that, both the teams will have their national anthems. It will be South Africa's first followed by India's.
